title: Mando's N-1 Starfighter
subtitle: Faster than a Fathier
text:
Support
On Attack: You may exhaust a friendly (non-upgrade) leader. If you do, this unit gets +2/+0 for this attack.
rules: You may exhaust leaders or leader units as part of Mando's N-1 Starfighter's ""On Attack"" ability. Upgrades can't be exhausted.
